name: infinite-bento-pan
title: Infinite Bento Pan
description: A hypnotic diagonal camera glide over an oversized grid of bento cards (charts, counters, code, gradients) with a vignette. All figures are filler.
useWhen: You need an ambient establishing shot that says a lot is happening here without asking anyone to read a number.
A background layer is wanted behind a title or logo, with dozens of dashboard cards drifting past.
avoidWhen: The figures on screen have to mean something: every counter, stat and chart here is filler; use a real chart block.
You need the camera to slow down, hold or land on one card: the pan is a single linear diagonal.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Pan distance
variables.description: Share of the grid the camera crosses (1 = the whole diagonal).

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of charts, bars and logo tiles.
